rows.value: The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is treated as the manufacturer, subject to Article 10 obligations, where the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product forming part of an assembly of machinery (Art. 18); a non-professional user modifying machinery for his or her own use is not considered a manufacturer.
rows.text: Under Article 18 of the Machinery Regulation, the natural or legal person carrying out a substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations in Article 10, where the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery. A non-professional user modifying machinery for his or her own use is excluded.

The manufacturer must keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market (or put into service), under Art. 12(2) and Art. 10(3).

rows.value: The first periodic verification of Annex VII equipment is carried out by INAIL, through its competent territorial operational unit and its personnel, within 45 days of receiving the complete request.
rows.text: Under DM 2011, art. 2, c. 1 (Annex VII), the first periodic verification is performed by INAIL, through the competent territorial operational unit and its personnel, within 45 days from the date of receipt of the complete request. Where the employer's delegated qualified body performs it on INAIL's behalf, different conditions apply.
The employer must keep the results of the checks under art. 71, paragraph 8 of D.Lgs. 81/2008 (DLGS71, art. 71, c. 9) for at least the last three years.

No. From 20 January 2027, vehicle servicing lifts are listed in Annex I, Part A, point 3 of the Machinery Regulation, so internal production control alone (module A) is not enough: Article 25(2) requires internal production control (module C) followed by EU type-examination (module B). Internal production control alone under Article 25(4) applies only to categories not listed in Annex I.

rows.text: The Regulation's Annex III, point 1.1.9 introduces the requirement that software and data critical for compliance be adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption, and that a hardware component transmitting signal or data be similarly protected where it is relevant for connection or access to such software. The Directive has no corresponding requirement.

The DEMAG overhead travelling crane (IGEA device 8) must be verified every year, per Allegato VII, riga 12 of D.Lgs. 81/2008, because it is a fixed lifting appliance over 200 kg used in the mining sector and built more than 10 years ago. Assumptions of the rule: truck cranes and mobile cranes are treated as mobile, overhead and gantry cranes and hoists as fixed, and the site's sector applies to every device.

The IGEA device 7 truck-mounted hydraulic crane must be verified once a year (P1Y), under Allegato VII, riga 12 of D.lgs. 81/2008 for mobile lifting equipment above 200 kg in extractive-sector use. Assumptions of the rule: truck cranes and mobile cranes are treated as mobile, overhead and gantry cranes and hoists as fixed, and the site's sector applies to every device.

rows.value: The ASL (Azienda Sanitaria Locale) carries out the periodic verifications after the first one on equipment listed in Annex VII.
rows.text: Under DM2011 art. 2, c. 1, the subsequent periodic verifications (those after the first) on the Annex VII equipment (art. 1, c. 1) are carried out by the ASL, while the first is carried out by INAIL.

The first periodic verification must be carried out within 45 days of receipt of the complete request (Art. 71, c. 11, D.Lgs. 81/2008, as stated in the Inail guide). The facts contain no sixty-day limit from the 2011 Ministerial Decree for the first verification; its only stated limit is thirty days for subsequent verifications (DM2011, art. 2, c. 1).
No. The UR5e is partly completed machinery and, under the e-Series conditions (ur5e-manual, p. 220), it shall only be put into service once integrated into a final complete machine.

The nanoScan3 protective device must undergo regular tests at least once a year (P1Y), per the nanoscan3 manual p. 50; the resolution detection test and the thorough check of its principal function are also due at least yearly (p. 51). A visual check is separately recommended daily.
The verifier must give IGEA 15 days' notice (P15D) of the planning of the checks, per the IGEA equipment contract, p. 5 (fact 0).

The overhead travelling crane at position 13 must be verified every two years (P2Y), under Allegato VII, riga 16 of the D.Lgs. list for fixed lifting equipment over 200 kg used in the estrattivo sector and not more than 10 years old. Assumptions of the rule: truck cranes and mobile cranes are treated as mobile, overhead and gantry cranes and hoists as fixed, and the site's sector applies to every device.

IGEA device 13 must be verified every P2Y on 2026-11-14: GRU A PONTE SCORREVOLE is lifting equipment of type fisso (mapping of the rule); capacity 5000 kg is above 200 kg; sector estrattivo: named in the row; built in 2017: not more than 10 years before 2026-11-14; Annex VII row for type fisso, sector use, age new. Assumptions of the rule: truck cranes and mobile cranes are treated as mobile, overhead and gantry cranes and hoists as fixed, and the site's sector applies to every device.
